scope: Same-time bookkeeping in frozen physical-source linear reference; no causal percentage, pure-phase or unique actual-FNA claim.
inputs_fixed: same response unit and positive orientation
common original grid and observation window
both zeta states evaluated at every anchor

normalization.A: max(abs(v)) over full frozen observation window
normalization.group_policy: Decompose modes first, then sum components in groups; normalization of pre-summed groups is a different decomposition.

mode_decomposition.both_A_zero: delta_v=0, allocated components0, h remains undefined
mode_decomposition.exactly_one_A_zero: dA/dh undefined; preserve entire delta_v in d0 unallocated, never fill an arbitrary h
mode_decomposition.precision_unresolved: flag separately; if decomposition is not reliable retain raw delta_v unallocated; do not erase terms or silently relabel printed zero as exact.

old_direction_projection.sigma5: sign(sum_r(v5(tau))), require resolved nonzero old reference total
old_direction_projection.negative: strengthens old-direction projection, offsetting weakening elsewhere
old_direction_projection.amplitude_decrease: Can give negative WA if it reduces a cancelling contribution.
old_direction_projection.CSI_mapping: Use reference sigma5 only, never infer native eta from this projection.

absolute_difference.old_zero_or_unresolved: Old-direction W not defined; retain raw decomposition and direct absolute difference.
absolute_difference.global_sign_invariance: Flipping all reference v and y signs flips dA/dh but leaves projected W and reversal correction unchanged.

anchors.evaluate: both zeta states and complete decomposition independently at every anchor; duplicate times keep labels
anchors.forbidden: Never add WA at old peak to Wh at new peak.
anchors.native_anchor: Neither reference anchor loss is automatically0
anchors.interpretation: Anchor losses are peak-location bookkeeping, not independent mechanisms.

minimum_checks: per-mode delta reconstruction, valid-mask and unallocated residual coverage
all300 modal components sum to same total; displayed partitions close separately
